summary.text: Christine Giguere is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 107, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
A candidate profile published by the Horry County Democratic Party says she has lived in Myrtle Beach for more than 30 years.

paragraphs.text: According to the Horry County Democratic Party's profile of her, Christine Marie Giguere has called Myrtle Beach home for more than 30 years.

The profile says she is running on a platform of compassion, accessibility and connection, and lists four priorities: protecting reproductive rights, raising the minimum wage, expanded accessibility for people with disabilities along with stronger protections for LGBTQ+ individuals, and improved local transit and infrastructure.
